methodologyNotes: Numeric specs use US units: water capacity in gallons (gal), interior/depth dimensions in inches (in), minimum chiller temperature in degrees Fahrenheit (F), chiller power in horsepower (hp), MSRP in USD. Included-chiller, filtration and Wi-Fi/app control are booleans; tub material is an enum. Single-person recovery tubs (with or without integrated chiller) only; inflatable kiddie pools and full hot-tub spas out of scope. Unpublished specs are null. Three candidates were dropped after exhaustive primary-source research: 'polar-monkeys-recovery-pod' (Polar Monkeys has never sold a product called Recovery Pod; confirmed via polarmonkeys.com and multiple review sources), 'coldture-arctic' (Coldture Wellness has no Arctic model; their lineup is Classic, Barrel, Pro, and Xtreme — confirmed via coldture.com collections page), and 'edge-tubs-pro' (Edge Theory Labs sold an Edge Tub Elite and Edge Tub Legacy but no 'Edge Tub Pro'; company is confirmed out of business as of 2025). The 'plunge-pro-xl' candidate with brand 'Plunge' does not correspond to any product sold by plunge.com; the Cold Plunge Pro XL is manufactured by Sierra Spas/Luxury Spas and recorded under that attribution. All prices reflect published MSRP or current list price at time of access (2026-06-23); promotional/sale pricing noted where relevant.
